open_points.subject: A03 sandbox network invariant and start check
open_points.text: “no network interface but the namespace's own loopback — up, as bubblewrap leaves it in a new network namespace, and reaching nothing outside the execution … which the kernel does not inspect or verify at run time — the start check (rule 8) asks only that a probe execution succeeds”
open_points.question: What evidence must establish that every execution actually has exactly one loopback interface, that it is up, and that it cannot reach anything outside the execution, given that the start probe is not required to check those properties and required test 10 does not require checking the loopback state or external reachability?
options: Treat the properties as an unverified assumption about the pinned bubblewrap release
Require release-time verification of interface set, loopback state and external isolation
Require the start probe to verify the network properties
open_points.default_guess: Treat them as release-qualified properties of the pinned bubblewrap setup and add release-time verification, while leaving the runtime start check unchanged.
